name: What can go wrong with kitchen painting and trim work?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with kitchen painting and trim work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Peeling, brush marks, sticky doors, and chipped edges are usually signs of poor prep, wrong product choice, or rushing between coats. If you’ve had a bad paint job before, ask how surfaces will be cleaned, sanded, primed, and cured before you approve the work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common failures are peeling, uneven finish, and chipped corners. Those problems usually trace back to weak prep or the wrong coating system.
